name: Artisan
tagline: AI SDR Ava for outbound prospecting
description: Artisan's flagship product is Ava, an AI Sales Development Representative that researches accounts, writes personalised cold outbound, manages cadences, and books meetings autonomously. $25M Series A in April 2025 brought funding to ~$46M with ~$5M ARR across 250+ customers.
pricingDetails: Employee tier: ~$600/month annual. Accelerate: ~$2,000/month. Enterprise: custom.
